sections.heading: Out of scope (curated, no category contract)

rows.reason: The SEASON is the axis. A bioluminescent paddle, a manatee swim and a pumpkin patch share no category and are not supposed to — seasonalFit() and the summer registry ARE the identity here, and demanding a category one would delete the rail.

A PLAN is the axis, so it is cross-category by construction — morning coffee, an afternoon on the water, dinner. When the owner's board is present (lib/localPicks.js) membership IS the identity: a human chose every row by hand for this town and this hour.

The SIGNAL is the identity. A real spike flag or a real creator video is a fact about the place, not about its category, and a category gate here would silently delete whatever kind of place is actually being talked about this week.

CREATOR-SOURCED is the identity and the pool enforces it: lib/railsData.js builds `creators` straight from the registry, so every row is there because a person filmed it. The rail is deliberately any-category — that is what a local posting actually looks like.
DISTANCE is the axis. "Worth the Drive" is a claim about the trip, not the category — a spring, a stadium and a museum can all earn the tank, and the pools already bound it to real destinations.
